correctness.rationale: The graph with one perimeter edge removed is an open two-row ladder plus one crossing edge. A perfect matching using that edge is impossible for even n and unique for odd n by forced alternation. The open-ladder extendible-matching complex admits a two-cone induction A_n≃Σ A_(n-2), A_1 contractible, A_2≃S^0. For odd n, the single exceptional simplex intersects the contractible open-ladder complex in exactly Ind(P_(n-1)): each chosen horizontal segment must be nonconsecutive and conversely extends by paired horizontals and remaining rungs. Null attachment gives ΣInd(P_(n-1)); the standard path three-periodic homotopy classification yields the claimed n mod6 branches. n=2 gives two connected components S^0. Independent direct enumeration of perfect-matchings, face sets and reduced Euler data n=2..8 agrees; finite checks do not establish the unbounded assertion.
